concept: To Make a Mixture from Two Mixtures
question: A trader has two types of sugar: one at Rs.30/kg and another at Rs.50/kg. In what ratio should they be mixed to sell the mixture at Rs.40/kg without gain or loss?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of first type of sugar = Rs.30/kg

Cost of second type of sugar = Rs.50/kg

Cost of mixture = Rs.40/kg

**Formula Used:**

Ratio = (Cost of second type - Cost of mixture) ÷ (Cost of mixture - Cost of first type)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Ratio = (50 - 40) ÷ (40 - 30)

⇒ Ratio = 10 ÷ 10

⇒ Ratio = 1 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 1.**
